text:
Marta: FYI ACME security pinged support — their long-running model streams drop around ~5-6 minutes when routed via their corporate firewall/NAT. They asked what ports/CIDRs/timeouts to request.
Jason: likely SNAT/NAT idle timeout. Many firewall appliances default to 300s. Also check ephemeral port exhaustion if they open lots of concurrent streams from few IPs.
Rachel: true. For HTTP/2 streaming we should recommend client keepalives (HTTP/2 PING) every 20-30s. Our SDKs need to mention this in the streaming guide.
Priya: checklist for customer (quick):
- increase outbound NAT idle timeout to >= 900s
- allow upstream ephemeral port range e.g. 32768-61000
- permit HTTP/2 ALPN + SNI passthrough for our hostnames if they do TLS inspection
- whitelist Redwood egress CIDRs (we'll provide official list via support ticket)
- avoid application-layer buffering on proxy (breaks chunked/streaming)
Samir: for customers that can't change FW rules we offer a Dedicated egress IP allocation (reserved SNATs) so streams originate from stable addresses. Also can consider a tiny keepalive reverse-proxy we host for them.
Marta: can someone paste example CIDRs they can use in their internal doc (placeholder only, will send signed list via ticket)?
Jason: example placeholders (DO NOT USE for production):
```
203.0.113.0/24
198.51.100.128/25
34.120.64.0/18
35.200.10.32/28
```
Priya: LB/proxy notes: ALB default idle timeout = 60s, upgrade to >= 600s for long streams; nginx proxy_read_timeout / proxy_send_timeout to match keepalives.
Samir: kernel TCP keepalive advice for customer hosts (example):
```
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time=60
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl=10
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_probes=5
```
Rachel: also add SDK snippet to trigger an application heartbeat if app-level timers are easier for customers.
Marta: perfect. I'll open a private support ticket and attach this checklist. @ingress-bot please create INF-4829 with ACME-Corp and request egress CIDR package.
ingress-bot: ticket INF-4829 created (private). assigned to marta. due in 48h. :white_check_mark:
Jason: if they confirm port exhaustion we can recommend SNAT pooling or a NAT gateway with higher ephemeral range. Keep me posted.
Marta: will do — I'll update once we have the finalized CIDR file and validation from the customer. :pray:
